named_premise_reduced: Actual address lookup/global tick allocator/own-program execution/full chronological journal/cohort type and per-record resources are derived under SAME retained-actuator map; no independent desired compatibility/binding/identity/funding fields supplied.
quantifier_and_semantic_review: For arbitrary n with actual actuator i:Fin n (hence no claimed n=0 realization), projectClocked keeps protected program/history, owner identity and clock. projectStore maps each existing Option slot, keeps length and None, and does not merge equal-valued owners or renumber addresses.

Timestamp transaction transport reuses SAME literal mode-step and cost/action/mode/label; global event clock is actual store.length. Lookup, child, retained-parent update and appended slot commute. Invalid lookup and failed birth still consume the same slot/tick; unsuccessful birth record Some with childNone differs from invalid transactionNone and both are retained.

Own-program mechanism is recomputed from actual lookup program on both scales. Literal compiledRequest factors through retained program/current actuator; arbitrary List dispatches commute, and compiledEpisode recursively computes requests from each ACTUAL prefix. No hidden-register controller factor is assumed or generalized to arbitrary fine controllers.

Actual childAt map derives exact numeric observedChildID and actualParent equality, with original same-childID→sameactual-parent directly consumed. This concerns actual children; None is no-born-child, not identity of a failed attempted actor.

Fixed OLD-address cohort through original s.length is retained; actual offspring/program arrays include None. Nonempty-birth domain is equivalent, including empty generations staying empty. No final-store census, expectation-of-ratio, independently supplied fertility/transmission kernel or Perron limit.

witness_actual_price calls original own_program_type_price on SAME fine n3/port1 actual offspring and original frequency/parentTrait; positivity is derived by actual cohort projection and old witness_birthCount. This is the actual offspring-only census and covariance divided by mean fertility; no unnormalized covariance substitution.

population_pmf_transport is for ANY common primitive PMF and common requests function, even one specified from complete raw episode; it is a transport theorem, not a blanket causal-policy admissibility claim. Actual compiledEpisode/witness_actual_requests separately derive the retained-field scheduler from actual fine prefixes.

Specific complete fourDrawLaw keeps ALL256 primitive words with their original nonuniform hazard/label product weights. The fourth request is actual prefix-dependent. Complete chronological journal law includes all outcomes/fees/failed births; no positive-word conditioning or re-draw. Invalid99 is additionally checked as a separate dispatch, not asserted to be an address generated by fourStepRequests.

Requested-idle inflow, cushion, finite list balance and path ResourceViable are literally retained. P6 transfers through SAME infinite recordPathLaw and paired original physical/projected memory seed with specified lifted compiled selector. It requires existing external requested-idle port g>=writeCost (including fault-requested idle supply) and reserve>=writeCost.

New independent consumer computes postStore from original full four-step witness and postParent by actual lookup.getD, then proves lookup=some(postParent) from actual post-repair physical readout. Its P6 seed is that exact organism with unchanged original physical state and matched projected memory; no assumed hp, existential replacement, reset or initial preparation. The totalization default is proved unused.

Original own-program population and requested-idle source remain separately declared model choices; no old fixed-global-mechanism program-match premise is erased. Single continuation P6 does not fund previous training/four-step costs or the population bank and does not assert global population optimality.

Parent actuator review already supplies exact nonfactorization/target-predicate obstruction when erasing the active coordinate; that exact source/review identity is reused, not rebranded as a new population obstruction.

actual_reuse.decision: DIRECT source reuse; projection carries literal same finite/infinite source and exact seed, not an externally specified projected law.
Existing owner/timestamp allocator semantics reused. Scale maps preserve organism projection and every address/clock; no substitute identity function.
DIRECT original actual-parent and Core Price consumers after derived complete-journal/fixed-cohort transport. Own-program semantics remain explicit rather than applied to old model silently.
DIRECT original requested-idle P6 via exact infinite-law pushforward and projected paired seed. Resources are SINGLE stream; no whole-population ledger supplied or inferred.

fresh_checks.imports: Exact frozen source explicitly, not claimed already publicly adopted.
